title: Bank statement cycle closing completed
description: This event indicates that the cycle closing has been completed for a specific target, such as an organization, program, or division.

target_type.title: Target Type
target_type.description: Defines the hierarchical level to which the cycle closing applies.

target_id.title: Target Identifier
target_id.description: The target ID for the cycle closing.

business_date.title: Cycle closing business date
business_date.description: The business date when the cycle closing event was triggered.

cycle_closing_datetime.title: Cycle closing datetime
cycle_closing_datetime.description: The cycle closing datetime that indicates the moment the event was issued. Note that the time is displayed in UTC, regardless of the target's local time zone.

next_business_date.title: Next business date
next_business_date.description: The next business date is the cycle closing date

division_code.title: Division code ID
division_code.description: Code string that identifies the division within your organization.

is_holiday.title: Holiday indicator
is_holiday.description: Indicates whether the business date is a holiday.

is_weekend.title: Weekend indicator
is_weekend.description: Indicates whether the business date falls on a weekend.
